overview: Extend qtip from single-interaction checks to ordered workflow scenarios with setup, steps, teardown, output capture, variable substitution, and step-level reporting while preserving backward compatibility.
goals: Support ordered multi-step scenario execution with per-step interactions and checks.
Enable step output capture and variable substitution across steps with deterministic precedence.
Add workflow-oriented check types for loop state and GitHub side-effect assertions.
Provide step-level diagnostics in text and JSON reports for fast failure triage.
Preserve existing behavior for single-interaction scenarios without migration.
nonGoals: Parallel execution within a single scenario workflow.
Conditional branching or looping constructs in scenario definitions.
Shared variable/state exchange across separate scenarios.
Direct GitHub API integration inside qtip runtime.
Automated migration tooling for legacy single-step scenario files.
successMetrics: Workflow scenarios execute setup, steps, and teardown in documented order with correct fail-fast semantics.
Existing single-interaction scenario fixtures continue to pass unchanged.
Workflow JSON output includes per-step status, duration, checks, and captured outputs.
New check types (loop_state, github_pr_exists, github_labels_match, github_comment_contains) pass defined positive and negative tests.
Quality gates pass for merged implementation commands.
openQuestions: Should `warn_only` be modeled per check only, or also as a step-level default override?
Should unresolved variables in setup abort immediately before any adapter call, or emit a preflight validation phase for the whole workflow?
Should step-level progress streaming be enabled by default or only under verbose mode?

stack.framework: TypeScript CLI orchestrator with Rust crates for catalog/executor
stack.hosting: Local CLI and CI runners (including GitHub Actions)
stack.database: None (YAML scenario files plus in-memory execution context)
stack.auth: Environment-provided credentials for external CLIs (for example `GH_TOKEN`)

routes.name: Scenario Evaluation
routes.purpose: Run subject evaluations for both single and workflow scenarios

routes.name: JSON Report Output
routes.purpose: Emit machine-readable evaluation results with workflow step detail

routes.name: Text Report Output
routes.purpose: Emit human-readable evaluation progress and per-step outcomes

uiNotes: CLI text output must show phase and step order clearly: setup -> steps -> teardown.
Failures should identify exact step name and failed checks without scanning raw evidence first.
Skipped steps must be visibly marked as skipped, not omitted.
Teardown warnings should be visually distinct from main step failures.

importFormat.description: Scenario YAML supports either legacy single interaction or workflow format with setup/steps/teardown and optional outputs.

rules: Scenario schema must enforce mutual exclusivity: `interaction` XOR `steps`.
Variable resolution order is environment variables first, then prior step outputs.
Unresolved variables fail the current step with explicit variable names.
`$$` in templates resolves to a literal `$`.
Setup runs first and sequentially; a setup failure aborts main steps but teardown still runs.
Main steps run sequentially and fail fast; remaining main steps are marked skipped after first blocking failure.
Teardown always runs and reports failures as teardown issues without overriding main-step pass/fail outcome.
Each step may specify an optional timeout override in seconds.
Step outputs support JSONPath extraction from JSON evidence and regex capture from stdout/stderr.
New check types must gracefully handle malformed evidence and return readable failures, never panic.
Single-interaction scenarios keep current execution path and report behavior except for explicit `kind` labeling where needed.

stories.title: Add Workflow Scenario Domain Models
stories.description: As a qtip developer, I want workflow-specific scenario structs and enums so that multi-step YAML can be represented explicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: Define `ScenarioKind` with `Single` and `Workflow` variants and add `ScenarioStep`/`StepOutput` domain types.
Example: parsing a YAML with `steps` yields `ScenarioKind::Workflow` and preserves step names in order.
Negative case: YAML that includes both `interaction` and `steps` returns a parse-time validation error.
No new npm package install is required for this story.

stories.title: Validate Workflow Parsing and Backward Compatibility
stories.description: As a qtip developer, I want robust parser validation so that invalid workflow definitions fail clearly and legacy scenarios remain unaffected.
acceptanceCriteria: Add parser tests for valid workflow files, invalid workflow files, and legacy single-interaction files.
Example: an existing single-step fixture still parses and executes as `Single` with unchanged checks.
Negative case: `outputs.from: body` or missing required step fields produce actionable parse errors.
Parser errors identify the offending field path for faster fixes.

stories.title: Implement Variable Resolver
stories.description: As a scenario author, I want `$variable` substitution in interaction templates so that later steps can reuse earlier outputs and environment values.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement template substitution for CLI commands and API/log string fields using a shared resolver.
Example: if env has `TEST_REPO=org/repo` and outputs also include `TEST_REPO`, resolution uses the environment value.
Negative case: unresolved tokens like `$loop_id` fail step preparation and list unresolved variable names.
Example: `$$HOME` renders as literal `$HOME` rather than attempting substitution.

stories.title: Implement Step Output Extraction
stories.description: As a scenario author, I want to capture values from step evidence so that downstream steps can reference concrete IDs and state.
acceptanceCriteria: Support output capture via JSONPath from JSON evidence and regex capture groups from stdout/stderr text.
Example: output mapping `loop_id <- $.loop_id` captures `smi-abc123` from command JSON output.
Negative case: regex pattern with no capture group match returns extraction failure for that output key.
Multiple outputs can be extracted from one step and merged into workflow context.

stories.title: Build Workflow Executor Lifecycle
stories.description: As a qtip user, I want setup, main steps, and teardown to execute with deterministic lifecycle rules so that workflow scenarios are reliable and debuggable.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `WorkflowExecutor` that runs setup -> steps -> teardown sequentially and records per-step `StepResult` data.
Example: when step 2 fails checks, step 3 is marked `skipped` and teardown still executes.
Negative case: setup failure aborts main step execution and still triggers teardown phase.
Teardown failures are reported distinctly without changing overall main-phase pass/fail determination.

stories.title: Support Per-Step Timeout Override
stories.description: As a scenario author, I want per-step timeout overrides so that long-running wait steps do not use the same limits as quick setup checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Executor honors optional step `timeout` value and passes it to the adapter call for that step only.
Example: `Wait for completion` with `timeout: 600` runs with 10-minute limit while surrounding steps use defaults.
Negative case: invalid timeout values (for example `0` or negative) produce validation or runtime errors with step context.
Timeout failures include step name and configured timeout in failure output.

stories.title: Add Warn-Only Check Behavior
stories.description: As a scenario author, I want non-critical checks to warn without failing the scenario so that optional side-effects can be monitored safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Support `warn_only: true` handling in step checks and mark warning outcomes in step/report details.
Example: cost-tracking check fails with `warn_only: true` and scenario still completes as passed.
Negative case: identical check with `warn_only: false` fails the step and triggers fail-fast for remaining main steps.
Warnings are visible in both text and JSON outputs.

stories.title: Implement loop_state Check Type
stories.description: As a scenario author, I want a dedicated `loop_state` assertion so that common smith loop checks are concise and consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `loop_state` check evaluator that inspects `$.state` or `$.record.state` from JSON CLI output.
Example: expected `synced` against `{"state":"synced"}` passes with clear pass details.
Negative case: expected `synced` vs actual `failed` returns explicit mismatch error with expected and actual values.
Malformed or non-JSON evidence yields graceful check failure without panic.

stories.title: Implement github_pr_exists Check Type
stories.description: As a scenario author, I want structured PR existence checks so that PR side-effects can be verified without custom JSONPath every time.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `github_pr_exists` evaluator with optional filters for `head_ref_pattern`, `base_ref`, `title_pattern`, and `state`.
Example: PR list containing `headRefName=smith-loop-123` satisfies `head_ref_pattern=smith-loop-.*`.
Negative case: no PR matching all provided filters fails with a diagnostic message.
Malformed JSON output from `gh pr list --json` results in clear evaluation error, not panic.

stories.title: Implement github_labels_match and github_comment_contains
stories.description: As a scenario author, I want label and comment checks so that issue side-effects are verified through reusable assertions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `github_labels_match` with support for subset and `exact: true` matching modes.
Example: labels `["bug","triaged"]` satisfy expected `["bug"]` when `exact` is false.
Negative case: expected exact labels `["bug"]` fails when output includes extras and `exact` is true.
Negative case: `github_comment_contains` fails when no comment body matches the configured regex pattern.

stories.title: Route CLI Execution by Scenario Kind
stories.description: As a qtip user, I want the CLI to choose the correct executor automatically so that both single and workflow scenarios run in one command.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI dispatches legacy scenarios to existing `ScenarioExecutor` and workflow scenarios to `WorkflowExecutor`.
Example: a single-interaction scenario run still produces the same pass/fail behavior as before.
Negative case: invalid workflow schema exits non-zero with parser validation details.
Execution routing is covered by command-level tests.

stories.title: Extend JSON Report for Workflow Detail
stories.description: As a tooling integrator, I want step-level JSON output for workflows so that downstream automation can identify exact failing phases.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow report includes `kind=workflow`, top-level status/duration, and arrays for `setup`, `steps`, and `teardown`.
Example: report records `outputs_captured.loop_id` for step `Create loop` and check-level outcomes for each step.
Negative case: single-interaction scenarios keep existing report shape and are tagged `kind=single` without workflow arrays.
JSON structure is documented and validated by reporter tests.

stories.title: Extend Text Reporter for Step Diagnostics
stories.description: As an operator, I want readable step-by-step console output so that I can debug workflow failures quickly in CI logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Text reporter prints ordered setup/steps/teardown sections with name, status, and duration.
Example: failing step output explicitly states `Step 2/4: Wait for completion` and includes failed check summary.
Negative case: skipped steps appear as `skipped` and are not mislabeled as passed.
Teardown failures are shown as warnings and clearly separated from main step failures.

stories.title: Add Workflow Test Coverage
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want end-to-end and unit coverage for workflow behavior so that regressions are caught before release.
acceptanceCriteria: Add unit tests for resolver, output extraction, and each new check type covering pass/fail/malformed evidence paths.
Example: integration test verifies setup pass -> step fail-fast -> teardown run semantics with expected statuses.
Negative case: unresolved variable and malformed check evidence tests fail predictably with explicit messages.
Example: `npm run rust:test` passes with newly added workflow test suites enabled.

stories.title: Publish Workflow Documentation and Example Scenarios
stories.description: As a scenario author, I want clear docs and examples so that I can adopt workflow scenarios without reverse-engineering implementation details.
acceptanceCriteria: Document workflow schema fields, variable precedence, timeout behavior, warn-only semantics, and supported check types.
Example: docs include a complete `GitHub issue to PR` workflow YAML demonstrating output capture and substitution.
Negative case: docs include an explicit invalid example where both `interaction` and `steps` are present and explain why it fails.
Migration guidance states that existing single-interaction scenarios require no changes.
